title: Run your sales agency's daily work through coding agents
summary: Workflows.io's co-founder says all 22 staff use Claude Code or Codex daily, wired into their sales tools and a shared notes repository, as revenue grew to $3.3M a year.
agent_role: Agents run client updates, campaign creation, content ideas and campaign tuning across connected tools. Humans own strategy and final review for most workflows.
outcome: Author reports workflows completing tasks up to 80%+ and the company growing from zero to $3.3M yearly revenue.
what_they_did: A co-founder of Workflows.io connected Claude Code and Codex to their sales and outreach tools, like HubSpot, Apollo, Slack and Notion. They keep company knowledge as plain text files in a shared code repository, one per client, fed with call transcripts and chat threads. Written procedures became reusable agent skills, some triggered automatically and reporting back in Slack.
how_it_went: The author says skills complete tasks like client updates and campaign creation up to 80%+. All 22 team members use the agents daily, and the company reports reaching $3.3M in yearly revenue.
worth_knowing: Most of their agent workflows still keep a human in charge: the agent does the work, and a person sets strategy and gives final review.
prompt: Help me set up an agent-run workflow for my business. First, read the procedures in [folder of process docs] and our client notes in [folder or repo]. Pick one recurring task, like [weekly client update], and turn it into a step-by-step skill you can repeat. Use my connected tools ([CRM], [email outreach tool], [chat app]) only to read data. Draft the output and show it to me for review. Do not send messages, change CRM records or launch campaigns until I approve.

curation.rationale: A real company's concrete setup for running sales operations with Claude Code and Codex connected to its tools, with named tools and structure; self-promotional and light on hard evidence or steps.
